mapper.select: SELECT cs.id, cs.schedule_date, cs.employee_id, cs.employee_name, u.position as employee_role, u.phonenum as employee_phone, cs.shift_type, cs.start_time, cs.end_time, cs.work_hours, cs.work_area, cs.status, cs.notes FROM jsh_cloisonne_schedule cs LEFT JOIN jsh_user u ON cs.employee_id = u.id AND u.delete_flag = '0' WHERE cs.delete_flag = '0' AND cs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cs.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate} AND cs.status IN ('normal', 'swap') ORDER BY cs.start_time ASC

INSERT INTO jsh_cloisonne_schedule ( schedule_date, employee_id, employee_name, shift_type, start_time, end_time, work_hours, work_area, status, notes, tenant_id, create_time, create_user, delete_flag ) VALUES
( #{item.scheduleDate}, #{item.employeeId}, #{item.employeeName}, #{item.shiftType}, #{item.startTime}, #{item.endTime}, #{item.workHours}, #{item.workArea}, #{item.status}, #{item.notes}, #{item.tenantId}, NOW(), #{item.createUser}, '0' )
mapper.select:
SELECT cs.id, cs.schedule_date, cs.employee_id, cs.employee_name, cs.shift_type, cs.start_time, cs.end_time, cs.work_hours, cs.work_area, cs.status, cs.notes, cs.create_time FROM jsh_cloisonne_schedule cs WHERE cs.delete_flag = '0' AND cs.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND cs.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY cs.schedule_date DESC, cs.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
